description: This file contains a module that performs documentation linting for TypeScript/JavaScript source files, analyzing class and method documentation consistency, and utilizing TypeScript compiler API for static analysis.

methods.name: paramsForMember
methods.description: Extracts parameter names from a documentation member if it is a method.

methods.name: listMethods
methods.description: Uses TypeScript compiler API to list methods of classes in a source file, filtering out certain methods.
